envelope.description: Guard the vault across the maintenance tool and a daemon

body.title: Guard the vault across the maintenance tool and a daemon
body.summary: Have the offline maintenance binary take the run-file guard before its pid and socket check and hold it until exit, and have a daemon's vault load fail without touching the Keychain while the guard is held.
acceptanceChecks: A daemon fails requests needing a secret while maintenance holds the guard and succeeds after release
Maintenance refuses and releases the guard when the daemon socket exists after acquiring it
The offline tool reads the vault once
